guide_title.speaker: narrator
guide_title.text: Welcome to Derpy Tiger Minecraft Three D with Sussie the Magpie, Rumi, and Mikey! Tap Play!

guide_welcome.speaker: sahur
guide_welcome.text: Roar hehehe! Derpy Tiger here! Tap the glowing Minecraft Lucky Block right in front of us!

guide_starter_pop.speaker: narrator
guide_starter_pop.text: Awesome! Honmoon Star Gems, a Peony Flowerpot Seed, and a Free Diamond Safe Spin!

guide_tap_block.speaker: narrator
guide_tap_block.text: Press Throw or tap any glowing Lucky Block to smash it open with Derpy Tiger!

guide_combo_sahur.speaker: sahur
guide_combo_sahur.text: Tiger paw, boomerang spin, pounce! Super Honmoon shockwave combo!

guide_boing_hint.speaker: narrator
guide_boing_hint.text: Boing! That Minecraft Boss has tough armor! Spin the Diamond Safe Chest to power up first!

guide_ready_tralalero.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_tralalero.text: Sussie Gat Hat Boomerang ready! Let us bonk the Bouncy Zombie Captain on the Village Rooftops!

guide_ready_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_bombardiro.text: Rumi Honmoon Light Blade ready! Let us bonk the Underground Drill Golem in the Torch Tunnel!

guide_ready_patapim.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_patapim.text: Zoomy Tiger Paws on! Let us bonk the Closet Portal Prankster in the Laser Security House!

guide_ready_king.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_king.text: Porcelain Peony Mallet ready! Defeat the Giant Security Boss at the Lava Vault to rescue Mikey!

vo_wpn_bat.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_bat.text: Sussie Gat Hat Boomerang! Spinning magpie hat power for smashing Lucky Blocks!

vo_wpn_gong.speaker: cappuccina
vo_wpn_gong.text: Swish sparkle! My Honmoon Light Blade slices through blocks and bosses!

vo_wpn_mallet.speaker: bananini
vo_wpn_mallet.text: Whirrr crunch! Underground Cookie Drill Pickaxe! Super tunnel mining power!

vo_wpn_taiko.speaker: lirili
vo_wpn_taiko.text: Bloom kaboom! Porcelain Peony Bloom Mallet! Giant Minhwa petal shockwaves!

vo_wpn_rainbow.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_rainbow.text: Ultimate Jackpot! The legendary Minecraft Diamond Rescue Sword of Champions!

vo_totem_tier1.speaker: bananini
vo_totem_tier1.text: Hooray! Derpy Tiger patted the blue and white porcelain flowerpot upright!

vo_totem_tier2.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier2.text: Yay! Our upright Porcelain Peony Pot is blooming and showering bright Star Gems!

vo_totem_tier3.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier3.text: Whoa! It grew into a Golden Minhwa Peony Tree! Maximum Star Gem fountain!

helper_cappuccina_wake.speaker: bananini
helper_cappuccina_wake.text: Caw caw! Sussie the six-eyed Magpie here! Blue Porcelain Peony Pot standing tall!

helper_bananini_wake.speaker: cappuccina
helper_bananini_wake.text: Rumi reporting! Upright Lotus Flowerpot glowing with cyan Honmoon magic!

helper_lirili_wake.speaker: sahur
helper_lirili_wake.text: Derpy Tiger purr! I patted the Minhwa Celadon Planter upright with my big blue paw!

helper_assassino_wake.speaker: lirili
helper_assassino_wake.text: Voxel Mikey here! Our Golden Honmoon Tree Pot is showering diamond stars!

fairy_pot_max.speaker: cappuccina
fairy_pot_max.text: All four Porcelain Peony Flowerpots are upright and maxed out! Star Gem fountain!

fairy_need_stars.speaker: narrator
fairy_need_stars.text: Smash more Lucky Blocks or pat your Peony Flowerpots for more Star Gems first!

wheel_open.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_open.text: Spin the Diamond Safe Chest for a Honmoon Light Blade, Drill Pickaxe, or Diamond Sword!

wheel_spinning.speaker: sahur
wheel_spinning.text: Round and round the Diamond Safe wheel goes! What awesome Minecraft gear will we win?

wheel_jackpot.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_jackpot.text: Diamond Safe Jackpot! Bonus Honmoon Star Gems and a glowing shield heart!

vo_drop_jackpot.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_jackpot.text: Whoa! Diamond Safe Star Gem Shower!

vo_drop_seed.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_seed.text: A Porcelain Peony Seed! Tap Upright to stand a flowerpot up and bloom it!

vo_drop_wheel.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_wheel.text: Free Spin Token! Let us spin the Diamond Safe Chest!

vo_drop_mango.speaker: narrator
vo_drop_mango.text: Yum! Buried Village Cookie Jar Treats!

vo_drop_latte.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_latte.text: Cyan Honmoon Portal Zoom! Super fast tiger paws and a bonus shield heart!

vo_drop_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_bananini.text: Hehe! Mini Rumi popped out cheering!

vo_drop_confetti.speaker: bananini
vo_drop_confetti.text: Hooray! Honmoon Sparkle Confetti and Sussie the Magpie!

vo_drop_toot.speaker: lirili
vo_drop_toot.text: Boing hop! Voxel Mikey popped out to help Derpy Tiger!

vo_gear_boots.speaker: lirili
vo_gear_boots.text: Zoomy Tiger Paws! Run and jump super high across the Minecraft rooftops!

vo_gear_crown.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_crown.text: Sussie Golden Gat Crown! Five glowing Honmoon shield hearts!

vo_gear_cape.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_cape.text: Honmoon Magnet Cape! Vacuum up every Star Gem around Derpy Tiger!

vo_boss_alert.speaker: sahur
vo_boss_alert.text: Ooh! Watch out! A Giant Minecraft Boss just hopped into the arena!

vo_pet_cappuccina.speaker: bananini
vo_pet_cappuccina.text: Caw caw! Sussie the six-eyed Magpie tips his hat and shares bonus Star Gems!

vo_pet_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_pet_bananini.text: Purr! Derpy Tiger wiggles his round cheeks and shares golden cookies with you!

vo_pet_lirili.speaker: lirili
vo_pet_lirili.text: Yay! Voxel Mikey gives Derpy Tiger a high five and five bonus stars!

boss_tralalero_spawn.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_spawn.text: Brrr boing! I am the Bouncy Zombie Captain! Stay off my village roof and cookie garden!

boss_tralalero_boing.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_boing.text: Rooftop bounce! Spin the Diamond Safe Chest for a stronger boomerang first!

boss_tralalero_ouch.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_ouch.text: Whoa! Derpy Tiger and Sussie just bonked me off the village chimney!

boss_tralalero_defeat.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_defeat.text: Hehe, okay, you can have the buried cookie jar and my Rooftop Trophy!

vo_win_tralalero.speaker: narrator
vo_win_tralalero.text: Hooray! Bouncy Zombie Captain bonked! Trophy one of four!

boss_bombardiro_spawn.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_spawn.text: Whirrr crunch! I am the Underground Drill Golem! This torch tunnel and carrot farm are mine!

boss_bombardiro_boing.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_boing.text: Tunnel bounce! Bring Rumi Honmoon Light Blade before you dig through here!

boss_bombardiro_ouch.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_ouch.text: Clang! That Honmoon Light Blade is slicing right through my rock armor!

boss_bombardiro_defeat.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_defeat.text: Rumble purr! The underground tunnel is clear! Take my Golden Tunnel Trophy!

vo_win_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
vo_win_bombardiro.text: Awesome job! Underground Drill Golem defeated! Two trophies won!

boss_patapim_spawn.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_spawn.text: Peek-a-boo! I am the Closet Portal Prankster! Mind the red security lasers!

boss_patapim_boing.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_boing.text: Laser bounce! Put on Zoomy Tiger Paws and grab the Cookie Drill Pickaxe first!

boss_patapim_ouch.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_ouch.text: Hey! Stop knocking over my wastebasket and jumping through the cyan Honmoon floor portal!

boss_patapim_defeat.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_defeat.text: Whoosh! The bedroom closet portal is all yours! Take my Portal Trophy!

vo_win_patapim.speaker: narrator
vo_win_patapim.text: Haha! Closet Portal Prankster bonked! Three trophies won!

boss_king_spawn.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_spawn.text: Halt right there! I am the Giant Long-Arm Security Boss! Passcode one two three four is locked!

boss_king_boing.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_boing.text: Vault bounce! Bring the Porcelain Peony Mallet or Diamond Rescue Sword to open this cage!

boss_king_ouch.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_ouch.text: Bzzzt! How did Derpy Tiger jump across my lava stepping stones and punch in one two three four?

boss_king_defeat.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_defeat.text: Clank! The iron cage is open, Mikey is free, and the Comeback Billboard is shining bright!

vo_win_king.speaker: narrator
vo_win_king.text: We did it! All four Minecraft Trophies won and Mikey is rescued!

vo_finale_parade.speaker: cappuccina
vo_finale_parade.text: Comeback Champions! Derpy Tiger, Sussie, Rumi, and Mikey lit up the Comeback Billboard!

vo_keep_playing.speaker: narrator
vo_keep_playing.text: Welcome back to Derpy Tiger Minecraft Hub! Let us keep jumping and smashing Lucky Blocks!

vo_chaos_on.speaker: sahur
vo_chaos_on.text: Two-X Honmoon Party Mode on! Every Lucky Block pops double Star Gems and fireworks!

vo_chaos_off.speaker: narrator
vo_chaos_off.text: Cozy Minecraft Adventure Mode! Sunny rooftop and garden fun!

sahur_sleepy_zzz.speaker: narrator
sahur_sleepy_zzz.text: Hold on! Win the earlier Minecraft Boss Trophy first before challenging this Boss!
